#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    cout.tie(NULL);

    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;

    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }

    vector<int> odd(n + 1, 0);
    vector<int> even(n + 1, 0);

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (a[i - 1] & 1) {
            odd[i] = odd[i - 1] + 1;
            even[i] = even[i - 1];
        } else {
            odd[i] = odd[i - 1];
            even[i] = even[i - 1] + 1;
        }
    }

    priority_queue<int, vector<int>, greater<int>> costs;
    int prev = 0;

    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        if (odd[i] - odd[prev] == even[i] - even[prev]) {
            costs.push(abs(a[i] - a[i - 1]));
            prev = i;
        }
    }

    int sum = 0;
    int count = 0;

    while (!costs.empty() && sum <= b) {
        sum += costs.top();
        costs.pop();
        ++count;
    }

    if (count == 0) {
        cout << "0\n";
    } else if (costs.empty() && sum <= b) {
        cout << count << "\n";
    } else {
        cout << count - 1 << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
